BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD

William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

To H[unt]: You think Fuseli is not a great painter

XXVI
Y
OU
 think Fuseli is not a great painter. I’m glad.
This is one of the best compliments he ever had.
